essence: Self-lit Lord shines by the Lady as śiva-to-earth world; that shining constitutes both making and aliveness; effecthood resolved as shining-dependence, veiling impossible.

sections.SUMMARY: Self-lit Lord shines by the Lady as śiva-to-earth world; that shining constitutes both making and aliveness. Two dilemmas resolve it: effecthood means shining-dependence (difference displayed, never real), and likeness cannot veil because veiling light self-destructs — the world being His life-breath cannot throttle its breather.

rasa.sthayibhava: vitarka (reasoning-press) through two staged objections to never-veiled
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is reasoning-press: shining, dilemmas, dissolutions, prāṇa-close. Dialectic relished.
